label: Semantic Segmentation (polygons)
description: Same models and inputs as Semantic Segmentation, but the result is one polygon per classified region (GeoJSON) instead of a mask, styled by class on the map.

model.title: Model
model.description: auto picks the best model for the selected inputs: flair-rgb-resnet34-unet (default) and landcover-segformer-b0 need the orthophoto (DSM/DTM optional), height-classes needs the DSM (DTM/orthophoto optional), geomorphons needs a DTM or DSM.

resolution_m.title: Processing resolution (m)
resolution_m.description: Ground sample distance of the processing grid; 0 uses the model's recommended resolution. Coarser is faster.

tile_size.title: Tile size (px)
tile_size.description: 0 uses the model default (fixed for ONNX models).

overlap.title: Tile overlap (px)
overlap.description: Overlap blended with a Hann window to hide seams; -1 uses the model default.

min_segment_area_m2.title: Minimum segment area (m²)
min_segment_area_m2.description: Regions smaller than this are merged into their neighbours.

smoothing_radius_px.title: Smoothing radius (px)
smoothing_radius_px.description: Majority-filter radius applied to the class map; 0 disables.

class_filter.title: Class filter
class_filter.description: Comma-separated class names to keep (others become background). Empty keeps all.

height_weight.title: Height fusion weight
height_weight.description: RGB models only: how strongly height above ground (needs DSM, ideally DTM) reweights the classes. 0 disables fusion.

elevated_threshold_m.title: Elevated threshold (m)
elevated_threshold_m.description: Height above ground separating elevated classes (buildings, trees) from ground classes in height fusion; 0 uses the model's value.

ground_window_m.title: Ground estimation window (m)
ground_window_m.description: DSM without DTM: size of the morphological opening used to estimate the terrain. Larger than the widest building.

low_threshold_m.title: Low object threshold (m)
low_threshold_m.description: height-classes: heights above this count as objects.

tall_threshold_m.title: High object threshold (m)
tall_threshold_m.description: height-classes: heights above this are high objects (trees, buildings).

vegetation_index_threshold.title: Vegetation index threshold
vegetation_index_threshold.description: height-classes with orthophoto: Excess Green (ExG) above this is vegetation.

geomorphon_flatness_deg.title: Geomorphon flatness (°)
geomorphon_flatness_deg.description: geomorphons: angles below this count as level.

simplify_tolerance_m.title: Polygon simplification (m)
simplify_tolerance_m.description: Polygons variant only: Douglas-Peucker tolerance for region outlines.
